caption: A plastic ruler is bent until it cracks, displaying a visible stress fracture that propagates.
positive_analysis:
Hands gripping the strip's ends apply opposing forces that bend it toward its center.
Increasing bend strain concentrates stress at the strip's midsection, initiating a crack.
The stress fracture propagates along the transparent strip, splitting it into two pieces.
